criteria.evidence: EditContactScreen is stateless: TmrTextField for Full name, Phone, City, LinkedIn (amber = draft.linkedin.isBlank()) and Portfolio, with a read-only 'Email · from Google' box that wraps after '@' and '.' through a ZWSP and keeps the real email as semantics text. Heading 'Contact'. The top bar comes from the unchanged ScreenChrome. EditorsScreenTest.rendersAllFieldsWithAmberLinkedInAndReadOnlyEmail. Both editors_contact_empty_linkedin baselines were read; at 337dp/font 2.0 the email wraps after '@' and the LinkedIn border is amber.

The draft is set once with compareAndSet(null, ...) from the first non-null emission. save() is single-flight (busy plus finished). It re-reads the latest profile and copies only fullName, phone, city, linkedinUrl and portfolioUrl (trimmed) plus contactUserStated = true; email, entries, skills and reviewedAt are untouched. The route goes back and then shows 'Contact saved'. Covered by EditContactViewModelTest and ProfileRealEntryWiringTest.contactSave_storesFieldsAndGoesBack, which also asserts contactUserStated.

isValid = name not blank, phone blank or ContactFieldValidator.isValidPhone, and every field <= MAX_TEXT_LENGTH. RegisterChromeAction.enabled = canSave. There is no error copy and no red state (D52/D75.1). LinkedIn and Portfolio are stored as typed. ProfileRealEntryWiringTest.contactSave_isDisabledUntilNameAndPhoneAreValid checks chromeActions.enabled in both directions.

A plural count line, an Add field plus a feature-local Add pill (canAdd: trimmed, non-blank, <=60, < 100 skills, not a case-insensitive duplicate), new skills go first, and chips use FlowRow with a 48dp remove target and 'Remove <skill>'. Done is always enabled: write() applies withPendingSkillAdded, then writes skills and userStatedSkills = kept (still present) + added this session. Back discards the VM draft. The editors_skills narrow baseline was read: the field and button stack at font 2.0 and chips wrap at word boundaries.

SUMMARY has the heading 'Summary', the prototype note, one TmrTextArea labelled 'Your summary', and no add button (canAdd is false for SUMMARY and onAdd ignores it). ListEditViewModelTest.summaryShowsNoteOneItemNoAdd; editors_list_summary baselines.

EDUCATION has no note, one text area per EDUCATION entry (the fixture renders 'B.Com, Finance · Symbiosis College, Pune · 2020', which matches the prototype LISTS item), and DashedAddButton '+ Add education'. educationHasNoNoteAndAddLabel; editors_list_education baselines.

ACHIEVEMENTS has the prototype note, six items on PrototypeFixtures and '+ Add achievement'. achievementsShowNoteSixItemsAndAddLabel. The narrow baseline was read: the note and items wrap at word boundaries with no ellipsis.

The D75.3 rules are implemented and tested. Unchanged items are untouched (unchangedItemKeepsImportedSourceBulletsAndId compares the full entries list). A changed item becomes the same id, USER_EDITED, confirmed, with organization, dates and bullets cleared. A blanked item is removed. A new item is USER_STATED, confirmed, gets neverUsedId over the original plus new entries, and goes after the last entry of its category. Nothing hidden is lost silently: toLine renders title · organization · start – end · every bullet, so the text area shows every field that an edit collapses, and ProfileEntry has no other content field. FactIdAllocator.kt is byte-identical to origin/revamp/274-upload (empty diff). EditRoleViewModel now calls FactIdAllocator().neverUsedId(EXPERIENCE, profile.entries, title), which keeps the same prefix and the '<prefix>-<8 hex>' format, and UNIQUE_SUFFIX_LENGTH is still used by randomBulletId. Partial because of finding 1: an unchanged imported (unconfirmed) achievement cannot be confirmed in this editor, which D74 requires #282 to offer.

All five forms use Column + verticalScroll with no fixed heights. Chips use FlowRow. The skills Add row stacks above font 1.3. EditorsLayoutTest walks every editor state at 337dp/font 2 and asserts no truncation and no mid-word break through TextLayoutResult. The contact, skills and achievements narrow baselines were read with no ellipsis, clipping or mid-word break.

The PR body reports verify-local green. CI at 7362aab9: Constitution policy, Static checks, App unit tests, Core unit tests, Feature unit tests, Lint, Screenshot tests and delivery-gates-pregate pass. Assemble APKs was still pending at review time. The diff adds no '!!' and no comments. Strings are in strings_editors.xml with the feature_profile_impl_ prefix, with no ATS or guarantee wording.

Editors store only typed text, with no parsing or suggestions. New entries are USER_STATED and confirmed, edited ones USER_EDITED. Ids are never reused (neverUsedId over the original plus new ids, deletedThenAddedNeverReusesTheDeletedId). Each Save copies only the fields it owns (saveLeaves* tests). contactUserStated is set on the Edit contact save. Partial because of finding 2: a summary typed in the Summary editor does not set the identity flag, although D77 puts summary in the identity block.

Skills: <=60 characters and <100 skills gate Add. List: changed or new items <=200, summary <=400, and Add only while entries + new < MAX_ENTRIES. Everything is enforced through canSave/canAdd with no message. Tests: overLengthItemDisablesSave, summaryOver400DisablesSave, addDisabledAtEntryLimit, saveWhileInvalidWritesNothing.

ProfileEntryProvider maps EditContactNavKey, SkillsNavKey and ListEditNavKey(section) to the real routes, and NavKeyPlaceholder.kt is deleted (its only users are gone). ProfileRealEntryWiringTest adds five real-entry tests with Hilt ViewModels (contact save, contact validity, skills add + Done, education add, summary edit). Each invokes chromeActions.handler and asserts the repository and goBack. The lead deletion of ProfileEntryKeysTest (4d88e7b2) is disclosed and follows D55/D75.8.

No production change. ProfileRealEntryWiringTest.settingsGearTap_opensSettings is unchanged and asserts SettingsNavKey on top. The Verifier emulator walk (MainActivity > Profile > Settings, screenshot) is still outstanding per the PR body.

MIGRATION_3_4 is one statement, ALTER TABLE profile ADD COLUMN contactUserStated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. The column name follows the existing camelCase profile columns; D76's 'contact_user_stated' was illustrative. The entity has @ColumnInfo(defaultValue = "0"). 4.json differs from 3.json only in that column, the field entry and the identity hash. DatabaseModule registers 1_2, 2_3 and 3_4 with no destructive fallback. DatabaseModuleTest opens a v1 production DB with a row through the real provider and reaches v4 (main ships v2, so every shipped version chains). ContactFlagMigrationTest opens a real v3 DB with a profile row, runs runMigrationsAndValidate(4, validateDroppedTables = true) and reads 0. The schema-version test edits are only 3->4 plus a rename. No other open branch is above v3. The mappers round-trip the flag. AccountDataArchiveWriter not exporting the flag is acceptable: it is internal provenance state, not user content.

The red-commit assertion name.endsWith("A") assumed a cursor position on a stateless field whose value never changes. The new assertion checks that a callback received text containing the typed 'A', which still fails if onFullNameChange is not wired. LinkedIn (empty field) keeps its exact isEqualTo("B"). This is an honest correction, not a weakening. The same commit also carries the planned NavKeyPlaceholder.kt deletion, which its message does not mention; this is cosmetic.

findings.rule: D74 (achievements stay unconfirmed until confirmed in their editor; #282 must offer that), I.1
findings.trigger: A user imports a resume. EntrySectionParser and RemoteResumeTextParser create ACHIEVEMENT entries with isConfirmed=false, and #275's Review confirms only EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION (D74). The user opens Profile > Achievements, reads the six lines and taps Save without editing. Each item takes the '!item.isChanged -> result' branch, so every achievement stays isConfirmed=false. TailorResumeUseCase (entries.filter { isConfirmed }) and confirmedWithinLimits never use them. The only way to confirm an achievement is to rewrite its text, which flattens it into a USER_EDITED line. The prototype has no other confirm control, so the shown-and-saved list is the only place to confirm.
findings.title: The list editor offers no way to confirm imported achievements (D74); saving an unchanged list leaves them unconfirmed and out of tailoring
findings.proof: In ListEditViewModelTest, seed ach-1 as source=IMPORTED, isConfirmed=false, load ACHIEVEMENTS, call saveAndAwait() without edits, and expect the saved ach-1 to have isConfirmed == true with source IMPORTED, title and bullets unchanged. At 7362aab9 it stays false. Suggested fix: on Save, set isConfirmed=true on unchanged shown items and keep their source, bullets and id. This needs a lead decision, because plan 282-c8 says 'entry untouched'.

findings.rule: D77 (the identity block includes summary; never replaced when user-stated), D73, I.1; cross-lane with #333/#335
findings.trigger: On the integrated base with #333's SaveImportedProfileUseCase.chooseIdentity, a user has an all-imported profile, never opens Edit contact, and types a new summary in Profile > Summary. Save writes only summary, and contactUserStated stays false. The user then uploads a newer resume. chooseIdentity checks contactIsUserStated(): every entry is IMPORTED and there is a sourceFileName, so it returns false. The flag is false, and the imported name is non-empty, so it returns importedIdentity. saved.summary = parsed.summary, and the summary the user typed is silently replaced. D77 says the identity block is name, email, phone, city, LinkedIn, portfolio, headline and summary, and that a user-stated block is kept whole. Only Edit contact sets the flag in this diff.
findings.title: A summary typed in the Summary editor does not set contactUserStated, so a later re-import overwrites it
findings.proof: At integrate (#335): in SaveImportedProfileUseCaseTest, seed an all-imported profile, apply ListEditViewModel SUMMARY save with 'Mine', import a resume with a name and summary 'Theirs', and expect summary == 'Mine'. On this branch the precondition is a ListEditViewModelTest asserting that a changed-summary save sets contactUserStated == true; it fails at 7362aab9.

integrate_notes: #333/#335: chooseIdentity must read CandidateProfile.contactUserStated first and OR it with the provenance proxy (D77). SaveImportedProfileUseCase on #333 builds the saved profile with existing.copy(...), so the flag carries forward. Keep it that way, and do not reset it on import.

#333/#335: FactIdAllocator.kt is byte-identical between 7362aab9 and origin/revamp/274-upload, so the merge is a no-op hunk. EditRoleViewModel's private neverUsedId is already gone here, which closes the #321 integrate note.
D76: this branch is the only one at Room v4, and every other open branch is at v3 or v2. Any later Room change takes version 5 and chains MIGRATION_4_5 after MIGRATION_3_4 in DatabaseModule.
D75.7/D77 also require SaveManualProfileUseCase to set contactUserStated. It does not exist on this base, so whichever lane lands the manual flow (#333/#275) must set the flag there.

#275 (Review mid-onboarding): the editors pop exactly one entry with navigator.goBack on save, the same as EditRoleRoute. If finding 1 is fixed by confirming on Save, #275's 'Looks right, continue' and the Achievements editor become the two confirm paths that D74 describes.
CI: only Assemble APKs was pending at review time; re-check it before merge. The Verifier emulator walk for 282-x4 is still outstanding.
